intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 (SPGFX3) is caused by hemizygous mutation in the CFAP47 gene on chromosome Xp21.

checks.claim: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 (SPGFX3) is caused by hemizygous mutation in the CFAP47 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: our experimental observations in humans and mice demonstrate that hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia
checks.explanation: The paper does not use the name SPGFX3, but it describes the same X-linked disorder caused by hemizygous CFAP47 mutation.

checks.claim: The CFAP47 gene is located on chromosome Xp21.
checks.evidence_quote: a hemizygous Xp21.1 deletion removing the entire CFAP47 gene
checks.explanation: A deletion at Xp21.1 that removes the whole gene places CFAP47 at Xp21.

paragraphs.text: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 (SPGFX3) is a form of primary male infertility. It is marked by asthenoteratozoospermia, meaning poor sperm motility and abnormal sperm shape, together with multiple morphological abnormalities of the sperm flagella (MMAF) (Liu et al., 2021).

checks.claim: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 (SPGFX3) is a form of primary male infertility.
checks.evidence_quote: Deleterious variants in X-linked CFAP47 induce asthenoteratozoospermia and primary male infertility.
checks.explanation: The title states that the disorder causes primary male infertility.

checks.claim: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 (SPGFX3) is characterized by asthenoteratozoospermia (poor sperm motility and abnormal sperm morphology).
checks.evidence_quote: Deleterious variants in X-linked CFAP47 induce asthenoteratozoospermia and primary male infertility.
checks.explanation: The title names asthenoteratozoospermia as a feature.

checks.claim: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 (SPGFX3) is characterized by multiple morphological abnormalities of the sperm flagella (MMAF).
checks.evidence_quote: All men harboring hemizygous CFAP47 variants displayed typical MMAF phenotypes.
checks.explanation: All affected men had MMAF.

paragraphs.text: Liu et al. (2021) studied 3 unrelated Chinese men with MMAF and primary infertility. They also studied an Australian man with severe asthenoteratozoospermia. All of these men showed typical MMAF phenotypes.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) studied 3 unrelated Chinese men with MMAF and primary infertility.
checks.evidence_quote: identified hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47 in three unrelated Chinese individuals with MMAF
checks.explanation: The three unrelated Chinese men with MMAF are described; primary infertility comes from the title.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) studied an Australian man with severe asthenoteratozoospermia.
checks.evidence_quote: WES data from an additional cohort of severe asthenoteratozoospermic men originating from Australia permitted the identification of a hemizygous Xp21.1 deletion removing the entire CFAP47 gene.
checks.explanation: One deletion was found in a man from the Australian cohort of men with severe asthenoteratozoospermia.

checks.claim: The 3 Chinese men and the Australian man studied by Liu et al. (2021) all showed typical MMAF phenotypes.
checks.evidence_quote: All men harboring hemizygous CFAP47 variants displayed typical MMAF phenotypes.
checks.explanation: The paper states this directly.

paragraphs.text: Liao et al. (2022) screened 7 men with MMAF and found CFAP47 mutations in 1 of them.

checks.claim: Liao et al. (2022) screened 7 men with MMAF.
checks.evidence_quote: we screened gene mutations in seven MMAF individuals
checks.explanation: The abstract says seven MMAF individuals were screened.

checks.claim: Liao et al. (2022) found CFAP47 mutations in 1 of 7 men with MMAF.
checks.evidence_quote: we screened gene mutations in seven MMAF individuals and found two novel mutations in CFAP47 (c.706G>A, Val236Met; c.1337C>T, Thr446Met) in one case.
checks.explanation: CFAP47 mutations were found in one of the seven people screened.

paragraphs.text: Liu et al. (2021) found hemizygous CFAP47 mutations in affected men and concluded that the disorder follows an X-linked pattern of inheritance.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) found hemizygous CFAP47 mutations in men affected with SPGFX3.
checks.evidence_quote: identified hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47 in three unrelated Chinese individuals with MMAF
checks.explanation: Hemizygous CFAP47 variants were found in affected men.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) concluded that SPGFX3 follows an X-linked pattern of inheritance.
checks.evidence_quote: hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia
checks.explanation: The authors conclude that the disorder is X-linked.

paragraphs.text: Liu et al. (2021) performed whole-exome sequencing in 3 unrelated Chinese men with MMAF. Each man carried a hemizygous missense mutation in the X-linked CFAP47 gene. None of the 3 variants appeared in human control population genome databases, and several bioinformatic tools predicted them to be deleterious. CFAP47 is highly expressed in testis. Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence showed clearly reduced levels of CFAP47 in sperm from all 3 men. Liu et al. (2021) also analyzed whole-exome sequencing data from a separate Australian cohort of men with severe asthenoteratozoospermia. In 1 man they found a hemizygous Xp21.1 deletion that removed the entire CFAP47 gene.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) performed whole-exome sequencing in 3 unrelated Chinese men with MMAF.
checks.evidence_quote: we conducted whole-exome sequencing (WES) and identified hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47 in three unrelated Chinese individuals with MMAF
checks.explanation: The paper states this directly.

checks.claim: Each of 3 unrelated Chinese men with MMAF studied by Liu et al. (2021) carried a hemizygous missense mutation in the X-linked CFAP47 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: identified hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47 in three unrelated Chinese individuals with MMAF
checks.explanation: The paper states this directly.

checks.claim: None of the 3 CFAP47 missense variants identified by Liu et al. (2021) was present in human control population genome databases.
checks.evidence_quote: These three CFAP47 variants were absent in human control population genome databases
checks.explanation: The paper states this directly.

checks.claim: Several bioinformatic tools predicted the 3 CFAP47 missense variants identified by Liu et al. (2021) to be deleterious.
checks.evidence_quote: were predicted to be deleterious by multiple bioinformatic tools
checks.explanation: The paper states this directly.

checks.claim: CFAP47 is highly expressed in testis.
checks.evidence_quote: CFAP47 encodes a cilia- and flagella-associated protein that is highly expressed in testis.
checks.explanation: The paper states this directly.

checks.claim: Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence showed clearly reduced CFAP47 levels in sperm from all 3 Chinese men with hemizygous CFAP47 missense mutations studied by Liu et al. (2021).
checks.evidence_quote: Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence assays revealed obviously reduced levels of CFAP47 in spermatozoa from all three men harboring deleterious missense variants of CFAP47.
checks.explanation: The paper states this directly.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) analyzed whole-exome sequencing data from a separate Australian cohort of men with severe asthenoteratozoospermia.
checks.evidence_quote: WES data from an additional cohort of severe asthenoteratozoospermic men originating from Australia
checks.explanation: The paper states this directly.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) found a hemizygous Xp21.1 deletion removing the entire CFAP47 gene in 1 Australian man with severe asthenoteratozoospermia.
checks.evidence_quote: permitted the identification of a hemizygous Xp21.1 deletion removing the entire CFAP47 gene
checks.explanation: A single deletion was identified in the Australian cohort.

paragraphs.text: Liao et al. (2022) screened 7 men with MMAF and found 2 novel CFAP47 mutations in 1 man: c.706G-A (val236 to met; V236M) and c.1337C-T (thr446 to met; T446M). Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence showed that CFAP47 was greatly reduced in this man's sperm. Levels of WDR87, a protein that interacts with CFAP47, were also much lower. The weak WDR87 signals that remained were found next to the sperm nuclei.

checks.claim: Liao et al. (2022) screened 7 men with MMAF.
checks.evidence_quote: we screened gene mutations in seven MMAF individuals
checks.explanation: The abstract says seven MMAF individuals were screened.

checks.claim: Liao et al. (2022) found 2 novel CFAP47 mutations, c.706G-A (V236M) and c.1337C-T (T446M), in 1 man with MMAF.
checks.evidence_quote: found two novel mutations in CFAP47 (c.706G>A, Val236Met; c.1337C>T, Thr446Met) in one case
checks.explanation: Both variants and the single carrier match the abstract.

checks.claim: Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence showed greatly reduced CFAP47 in sperm from the man with CFAP47 V236M and T446M mutations reported by Liao et al. (2022).
checks.evidence_quote: Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence revealed that CFAP47 was dramatically reduced in spermatozoa from the CFAP47-mutated man.
checks.explanation: 'Greatly reduced' restates 'dramatically reduced'.

checks.claim: WDR87 is a protein that interacts with CFAP47.
checks.evidence_quote: we identified a cilia- and flagella-associated protein, CFAP47, which interacted with WDR87 in the flagellar midpiece of the spermatozoa
checks.explanation: The abstract states that WDR87 and CFAP47 interact.

checks.claim: WDR87 levels were much lower in sperm from the man with CFAP47 V236M and T446M mutations reported by Liao et al. (2022).
checks.evidence_quote: Meanwhile, the expression of WDR87 was also significantly decreased
checks.explanation: WDR87 expression was significantly decreased in the mutated man's sperm.

checks.claim: Residual weak WDR87 signals in sperm from the man with CFAP47 V236M and T446M mutations reported by Liao et al. (2022) were located next to the sperm nuclei.
checks.evidence_quote: weak signals were detected adjacent to the spermatozoa nuclei
checks.explanation: The remaining weak WDR87 signals were next to the sperm nuclei.

paragraphs.text: Liao et al. (2022) showed that CFAP47 interacts with WDR87 in the middle piece of the sperm flagellum. In sperm from a man with CFAP47 mutations, WDR87 levels were reduced and the protein was mislocalized. From these findings the authors proposed that CFAP47 is needed to transport WDR87 while the sperm flagellum is being built. They also proposed that the 2 proteins form a complex that takes part in sperm tail assembly.

checks.claim: Liao et al. (2022) showed that CFAP47 interacts with WDR87 in the middle piece of the sperm flagellum.
checks.evidence_quote: CFAP47, which interacted with WDR87 in the flagellar midpiece of the spermatozoa
checks.explanation: The interaction in the flagellar midpiece is stated directly.

checks.claim: In sperm from a man with CFAP47 mutations, WDR87 levels were reduced (Liao et al., 2022).
checks.evidence_quote: Meanwhile, the expression of WDR87 was also significantly decreased
checks.explanation: WDR87 was reduced in the CFAP47-mutated man.

checks.claim: In sperm from a man with CFAP47 mutations, WDR87 was mislocalized (Liao et al., 2022).
checks.evidence_quote: weak signals were detected adjacent to the spermatozoa nuclei, indicating that CFAP47 was necessary for WDR87 transportation
checks.explanation: WDR87 normally sits in the middle piece; in the mutant it was found next to the nuclei, and the authors read this as a transport defect. That amounts to mislocalization.

checks.claim: Liao et al. (2022) proposed that CFAP47 is required to transport WDR87 during sperm flagellum formation.
checks.evidence_quote: indicating that CFAP47 was necessary for WDR87 transportation during spermatozoa flagella biogenesis
checks.explanation: The draft restates the authors' interpretation.

checks.claim: Liao et al. (2022) proposed that CFAP47 and WDR87 form a complex involved in sperm tail assembly.
checks.evidence_quote: interacts with CFAP47 to form a complex which is involved in spermatozoa tail assembly
checks.explanation: The draft restates the authors' conclusion.

paragraphs.text: Liu et al. (2021) reported that men with asthenoteratozoospermia caused by CFAP47 mutations had good clinical outcomes with intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI). In Cfap47-mutant mice, ICSI restored fertility. The authors suggested that the prognosis with ICSI is good.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) reported that men with asthenoteratozoospermia caused by CFAP47 mutations had good clinical outcomes with intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI).
checks.evidence_quote: However, fertility could be rescued by the use of intra-cytoplasmic sperm injections (ICSIs). Altogether, our experimental observations in humans and mice demonstrate that hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia, for which good ICSI prognosis is suggested.
checks.explanation: The abstract shows ICSI rescue only in mice and merely suggests a good prognosis. It does not report actual ICSI outcomes in men. Only a later citing paper (Meng et al., 2023) says the affected men had good outcomes.

checks.claim: ICSI restored fertility in Cfap47-mutant mice (Liu et al., 2021).
checks.evidence_quote: However, fertility could be rescued by the use of intra-cytoplasmic sperm injections (ICSIs).
checks.explanation: This sentence follows the description of the mouse model.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) suggested that the prognosis with ICSI is good for men with CFAP47 mutations.
checks.evidence_quote: hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia, for which good ICSI prognosis is suggested
checks.explanation: The paper states this directly.

paragraphs.text: Liu et al. (2021) produced a Cfap47-mutant mouse model carrying a frameshift mutation. Adult male mice were sterile. Their sperm had reduced motility, abnormal flagellar shape, and abnormal flagellar movement. ICSI restored fertility in these mice.

checks.evidence_quote: We also generated a Cfap47-mutated mouse model
checks.explanation: The abstract says only that the model was 'Cfap47-mutated'. The frameshift detail appears only in a later citing paper (He et al., 2025), not in the abstract.

checks.claim: Adult male Cfap47-mutant mice were sterile (Liu et al., 2021).
checks.evidence_quote: the adult males of which were sterile
checks.explanation: The paper states this directly.

checks.evidence_quote: presented with reduced sperm motility and abnormal flagellar morphology and movement
checks.explanation: The paper states this directly.

checks.claim: Sperm from Cfap47-mutant mice had abnormal flagellar morphology (Liu et al., 2021).
checks.evidence_quote: presented with reduced sperm motility and abnormal flagellar morphology and movement
checks.explanation: The paper states this directly.

checks.claim: Sperm from Cfap47-mutant mice had abnormal flagellar movement (Liu et al., 2021).
checks.evidence_quote: presented with reduced sperm motility and abnormal flagellar morphology and movement
checks.explanation: The paper states this directly.

checks.claim: ICSI restored fertility in Cfap47-mutant mice (Liu et al., 2021).
checks.evidence_quote: However, fertility could be rescued by the use of intra-cytoplasmic sperm injections (ICSIs).
checks.explanation: The paper states this directly for the mouse model.

clinical_synopsis.feature: Multiple morphological abnormalities of the sperm flagella (MMAF)

paragraphs.text: Liao et al. (2022) described a man with MMAF who carried a c.706G-A transition in the CFAP47 gene, resulting in a val236-to-met (V236M) substitution. He also carried a T446M mutation. Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence showed that CFAP47 was greatly reduced in his sperm, and WDR87 levels were also much lower.
